messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock launch criteria for the perf sprint. Sales: AcmePay wants p95 < 120ms for chat. Finance: minimize cost per 1k tokens. Eng bandwidth is limited. Proposing we apply RICE + gating to pick work: cache/prefetch, batching/autoscale, quantization. Thoughts?

alex: Suggest we slice by "hotpath" vs "bulk". Hotpath = latency-first, bulk = cost-first. Proposed gate for hotpath: must reduce p95 by >=20% AND not increase token cost >5%. If both true -> high priority. :thumbsup:

devon: Sequencing idea: 1) prefix/KV cache + prefetch (low risk, quick wins) 2) smart batching + autoscale 3) aggressive quant + kernel tuning. Cache is usually fastest to roll out.

samir: Bench quick dump:
```
workload: chat-short (avg tokens=40)
baseline p95=160ms, cost/1k= $0.95
cache only -> p95=110ms (-31%), cost/1k= $0.99 (+4%)
batching only -> p95=170ms (+6%), cost/1k= $0.72 (-24%)
cache+batching -> p95=120ms (-25%), cost/1k= $0.78 (-18%)
quant (int8) -> p95=130ms (-19%), cost/1k= $0.50 (-47%) but eval risk
```
Numbers from last week's bench on p4d.

alex: Those numbers line up. So RICE-wise: cache (reach=high, impact=high, confidence=0.8, effort=low) -> top. Batching helps cost but harms tail on spikes. We should capture that in scoring.

maria: OK. We also need launch criteria and rollout plan. My draft gate for shipping any perf change: 1) measurable improvement on customer-slice (p95 and cost) 2) automated acceptance test in CI for top 50 prompts 3) canary rollout plan 4) monitoring + alert playbook.

devon: I can own canary. Proposal: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 24h windows, metrics: p95, qps, error rate, token cost per 1k. Rollback if p95 regress >5% or errors >2x.

samir: Important callout: quantization changes model outputs. Add eval requirement: top-100 prompt eval with <1% regression in quality metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim). Also require post-canary manual review for customer-facing cohorts.

maria: Agreed. Action items: Alex -> RICE table + prioritize tickets by EOW. Devon -> rollout plan + automation checks. Samir -> eval harness + top-100 prompt suite. I'll draft PRD with gates and acceptance tests and share Monday. I'll ping @eng and @sales for signoff. Thanks all. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Note — canary configs must be uploaded to infra before rollout. Reminder: include fallback model variant and auto-failover rule in config.
